disclosureQuote: AI tools were used in the creation of this game.
summary: 轻量农场放置模拟，2026 年 10 月 30 日上架，Delayed Victory 开发并发行，分类为休闲／独立／模拟：种作物、在自家小卖部上架出货，用收入换工具与地皮，把第一块小田扩成整片农场。商店 AI 披露只写到“开发本作时使用了 AI 工具”，没有点名任何领域，也没有说明用途范围与是否随游戏分发，因此本站设置“范围未指明”标记，八个领域全部登记为未说明，不做任何推测归类。未检索到第三方报道或开发者补充说明。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。
reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（未被截断，仅一句且未点名领域）与身份（开发与发行均为 Delayed Victory，正式版，2026 年 10 月 30 日）；英文讨论区首页可见 15 个主题、总数 42，即只覆盖首页，主题集中在声望代币、种植区大小与成就等玩法问答，没有 AI 相关讨论。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，6 条结果），登记并读取 1 条来源：HowMuchAI 的本作条目页，其转录文本与商店一致，该站“按部件”的分级为第三方自动判断，本站不采纳。其余五条里两条是商店页（本体与 DLC 支持包，已有官方取证或属附加商品）、一条是聚合站首页、一条是开发者销量分页清单、一条是月度发售日历页。未检索到独立媒体报道，也没有开发者对披露范围的补充说明；披露过于笼统时本站拒绝猜领域，八领域全部登记为未说明。
description: 一块地、一间小卖部：种下新作物、摆上货架换升级，再买新田把围栏往外挪，把最初的几分地滚成一整座农场。

english.summary: A light farm idle simulation released on Oct 30, 2026, developed and published by Delayed Victory and filed under Casual, Indie and Simulation, where you grow crops, sell them through your own farm shop, reinvest into tools and new fields and push the fences outward. The Steam AI disclosure only says that AI tools were used in the creation of the game, naming no area, no scope and no statement about whether anything ships with the build, so this site sets the scope unspecified flag and records all eight areas as not addressed instead of guessing. No third party reporting and no further developer clarification were found, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, one sentence that names no discipline, plus the identity with Delayed Victory as both developer and publisher on a full release dated Oct 30, 2026. The first page of the English discussion board shows 15 visible topics out of 42 in total, so only the front page was covered and its threads are prestige tokens, planting area and achievement questions with no AI topic. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json with 6 results, and one source was registered and read in full, the HowMuchAI entry page for this game, whose transcription matches the store text while its part by part grades are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. Of the remaining results two were store pages for the base game and its supporter pack, one the aggregator homepage, one a developer sales listing and one a monthly release calendar. Because the disclosure is too vague to assign a discipline, the scope unspecified flag is set and all eight areas are recorded as not addressed rather than inferred.
